mermaid:
flowchart LR
    DB["Platform database"]
    CORE["Platform core process"]
    PLUG["In-process plugin"]
    THEME["Theme code"]
    FUNC["Function at an extension point"]
    API["Versioned API and webhooks"]
    APP["App outside the process"]
    PLUG -->|"reaches anything"| DB
    PLUG -->|"replaces core logic"| CORE
    THEME -->|"renders the page"| CORE
    CORE -->|"fixed input, time budget"| FUNC
    FUNC -->|"fixed output"| CORE
    CORE -->|"scopes decide what"| API
    API <-->|"read or write by scope"| APP

sequenceDiagram
    participant WMS as the WMS
    participant IP as the iPaaS
    participant PL as the platform
    participant PO as the pre-order app
    participant SF as the storefront
    WMS->>IP: Counted stock, 120 units
    IP->>PL: Set available to 120
    PO->>PL: Pre-order received, adjust by minus 5
    PL-->>SF: Shows 115
    IP->>PL: Hourly set available to 120
    PO->>PL: Another pre-order, adjust by minus 5
    PL-->>SF: Shows 115, two pre-orders lost
    PO->>PL: Re-sync all pre-orders, adjust by minus 10
    PL-->>SF: Shows 110, then lower after each re-sync
    Note over PL,SF: Two weeks later 600 variants show sold out while Duiven has stock
